description:
Cassandra Developer
 Current project is based on Mainframe DB2 database.
 Planning to migrate DB2 to Cassandra for performance and scalability reasons.
 Two DBs to be migrated in a phased approach.
 Requirement is for onsite contractor.
 Must be hands on in NoSQL database Cassandra. 
 Good knowledge of Datastax Cassandra.
 If candidate has good experience in HBase and knows the concepts of Cassandra that is fine too.
 Candidate not expected to architect Cassandra but only hands-on development/implementation.
 The application integrated to the DB using Java and REST APIs. So good to have Java experience too.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
